title: Santa-hat bat ornament
subtitle: Traced from your wall photo · 50 mm across · black base with the red hat and white trim layered on top · shown standing as it hangs · millimetres
scale_note: Real size: 50 mm across (your pick). The photo looks along the wall, so the bat appeared squashed sideways; it's stretched 1.23× to undo that (estimated from the round pom-pom).
notes_title: v4: what changed, what to check
notes: v4, built for less waste: the bat is a plain black 2 mm base (including the loop). The red hat (0.6 mm) and white brim + pom-pom (0.8 mm) are thin layers printed on top, like the paper hat glued on. All the colour changes happen in the top 4 layers, about 5 swaps instead of ~25. The back is now a plain black bat. Check: the raised hat look, and whether the 2 mm loop hole suits your hook or thread.
